pressure.title: Counter-current washing recovers caustic
pressure.description: Mud moves forward (left → right) while wash water moves backward (right → left). Each stage dilutes the soluble soda and alumina left in the mud, so the liquor strength falls from red (first washer) to blue (last). Recovered liquor returns to the circuit; washed mud goes to residue storage. Typically 4–7 washers are used, with flocculant to speed settling.

foundation: Large ring foundation or concrete tank; centre pier carries the rake drive and torque.
alignment: Level launders so overflow is even all round; centre the drive and shaft.
piping: Feed to feedwell with flocculant dosing points; underflow pumps with standby and flushing; overflow to downstream.
commissioning: Fill with water, run rakes and test torque alarms and lift; start feed and flocculant; build mud bed gradually.

video_tutorials.title: Red Mud Washer — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Red Mud Washer.
Red mud washers are thickeners arranged in a counter-current decantation (CCD) train.
Mud is pumped forward from washer to washer while wash water flows backward; each stage dilutes and recovers the dissolved caustic soda and alumina in the mud.
Typical applications include residue washing in Bayer refineries; counter-current decantation in hydrometallurgy (e.g. copper, uranium).

The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Washer 1: Rake Arms & Blades (move mud to the centre cone), Washer 2: Rake Arms & Blades (move mud to the centre cone), Washer 3: Rake Arms & Blades (move mud to the centre cone).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Red Mud Washer works.
Mud from the settler enters washer 1.
Mud settles and rakes move it to the cone.
Underflow goes forward to the next washer.
Overflow liquor goes backward.
Washed mud leaves the last washer.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Mud moves forward (left → right) while wash water moves backward (right → left).

video_tutorials.title: Red Mud Washer — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Red Mud Washer.
Monitor torque, bed level, overflow clarity.
Check flocculant system.
Rake and drive inspection.
Watch for rake bogging: high torque trip. Common cause: mud bed too high.
Watch for dirty overflow: solids in liquor. Common cause: poor flocculation.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
